title: Exploring Robustness of LLMs to Paraphrasing Based on Sociodemographic Factors
reasoning: The paper focuses on the robustness of LLMs to linguistic variations based on sociodemographic factors like age and gender using the SocialIQA dataset. While it evaluates social reasoning (intent, reaction), it does not specifically benchmark religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems, and its ethical considerations section is a standard requirement rather than the core evaluation component.
